name: City of Jewels
epithet_and_role: lost city of jewels; capital and home of the player's previous incarnation; hub of all the Empire's administration — without it the empire would fracture
features: made by the great Law Giver; the Sumerian ending razes its foundations

name: City of the Dead
epithet_and_role: home of the biggest ancestor cult; underworld queen cult and dead cult in all of the Empire
features: streets filled with skulls; dog and owl engravings ward houses; biggest assortment of ritual scrolls for speaking with underworld spirits; greatest temple built within the earth with a great statue of the queen of the underworld

name: City of the Sky
epithet_and_role: cult center of the Sky Father An and the Lady of the Skies on top of a sacred hill; one of the oldest cities; first city on which the northerners lowered kingship

name: City of Kings
epithet_and_role: hub of the god of kings Enlil; center from which the legacy of kings is mummified and guarded
features: the Garden of the Gods (biggest temple of all the gods — every aspect of creation present); massive underground catacombs where the greatest kings join the ancestors in the Kingdom of the Dead

name: City of the Sun
epithet_and_role: headquarters of the guild of paladins

name: City of the Moon
epithet_and_role: capital of the enigmatic Prophet; home of the rebellious alliance of southern city states; one of the oldest and the richest (direct sea trade routes)
features: temple of sun and moon; the Great Lighthouse; hub of trade and scholarship

name: City of the Abyss
epithet_and_role: the oldest city in the lands; also called the city of Mystics
features: worship of primordial water since the dawn of creation; shifted from the two waters to the Water Lord and the Swamp Queen

name: City of the Warrior Spirit
epithet_and_role: once the city of the former sun god of the Taurissian people
features: now ruled by a mighty warchief of the eastern barbarian alliance

name: e-ab-kur-irkalla-ki = Gravestone
epithet_and_role: home of the cult of the dead
features: home of the earth mother of the underworld
